# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 04 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Industry Changes: Agents & Listings

- **Property agents face new transaction requirement from 2027** - From 1 January 2027, agents in Singapore must complete at least three qualifying transactions over a three-year registration period, or pass an assessment, to remain registered under new CEA rules. CEA is also extending registrations to three years. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/property-agents-must-meet-new-transaction-requirement-from-2027-cea-extends-registrations-to-three-years/)

- **Proposal floated to let homeowners list properties directly without agents** - Following the government's 28 July announcement of major changes to the property agent industry, a proposal is being discussed to allow individual homeowners to list properties on online portals without engaging an agent — though the article notes it is not straightforward. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/could-this-proposed-move-let-homeowners-sell-without-property-agents-its-not-that-simple/)

## Residential Market: New Launches & Resale

- **New ABSD rules could improve en bloc prospects for older condos** - Developers of large collective sale projects now have six to seven years to complete and sell, up from 5.5 years, under Singapore's updated ABSD rules — a change that may affect en bloc viability for older developments. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-change-boost-en-bloc-chances-for-older-condos-buyers-still-need-to-be-careful/)

- **Dunearn House sells 56% of units in first weekend despite strong preview turnout** - The first private residential project at the Turf City precinct attracted around 5,900 preview visitors but moved only 212 of its available units during its opening sales weekend. [Source](https://www.propertysoul.com/2026/08/02/dunearn-house/)

- **2-room Dawson HDB flat transacts at S$490,000 — the lowest in its cluster** - A newly MOP'd 2-room flat in Dawson, Queenstown changed hands at S$490,000, reported as the cheapest unit in its cluster, reflecting demand for newer flats in the area. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/490k-2-room-flat-is-the-cheapest-in-new-dawson-hdb-cluster/)

## Commercial Property

- **Office and retail rents both rose in Q2 2026 despite higher vacancies** - Singapore office rents increased 0.8% and retail rents rose 0.6% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, reversing declines seen in Q1 2026, even as vacancy rates moved higher across both sectors. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/office-and-retail-rents-rose-in-q2-2026-despite-higher-vacancies/)
